concerns.text: FR-001 (Synthetic Data Generation) and SC-005 (Validity Threshold) lack implementation tasks. T011 and T012 (Logic/Grid generators) are marked as 'rejected' (unchecked), yet T015b (Validation Gate) is marked complete. Without T011/T012, the system cannot generate the data required to validate against SC-005 or feed US2/US3.

FR-002 (Training Loop Parity) and FR-003 (Co-evolving Exchange) lack implementation tasks. T020 (CoevolvingAgent) and T022 (ParityChecker) are marked 'rejected', but T023 (Training Loop) is marked complete. The core experimental engine cannot function without the parity enforcement and co-evolving logic.

FR-004 (Held-out Evaluation), FR-005 (Forgetting Rate), and FR-006 (ANOVA) lack implementation tasks. T026 (Evaluation), T027 (Statistical Analysis), and T031 (Retention Rate) are marked 'rejected'. T034 (Full CLI) is marked complete, implying the pipeline runs, but the analysis components required to produce the results for SC-001, SC-003, and SC-004 are missing.

SC-004 (Statistical Power N≥30) requires a batch runner to execute 30+ runs. T029 (Batch Runner) is marked 'rejected', and T030 (Data Aggregation) is 'rejected'. There is no task to generate the 30 distinct seeds/runs or aggregate the results, making the statistical power requirement untestable.

T008a, T008b, T008c (Schema Generation) are marked 'rejected', yet T008 (Schema Validators) is marked complete. The validators cannot exist without the schema definitions they validate, breaking the dependency chain for contract tests T009/T010/T016/T024.

T008a, T008b, T008c, T011, T012, T013, T014, T017, T020, T021, T022, T026, T027, T028, T029, T030, T031, T032, T033, T035, T036, T037, T038, T039b1, T039b2 are marked with a checkbox ' ' (incomplete) or 'rejected' status in the text description, yet the file header implies a 'Tasks' document ready for execution. The status markers are inconsistent with the 'tasked' stage expectation of a complete plan.
